additional_scope: artifact_lifecycle.py inventory only; relocation/quarantine support modules not fully reviewed
notes: Strict scans report errors without substituting zero capacity or missing object claims.
Symlink and nonregular entries are reported or refused; unknown owner files are retained.
Registered, corrupt, missing, quarantine and purged identity sets are separate; capacity reports distinguish logical bytes and inode estimates.
Read-only inventory is not cleanup authorization.
